fields.Summary: Novel chemical additive plus dry coating processes to enhance Li-ion batteries with the use of Graphene in their Cathode)
fields.Deal investment thesis:
1\. QuantumScape & the likes (new battery tech altogether) are too far away from mass production and will not replace Li-ion even once they do start to hit production: Anaphite can get there faster and aims to be the ARM of Battery IP development for manufacturers today. tomorrow, and beyond.

2\. The current competitors are focusing either on building their own battery models, mostly using Graphene Oxide and building their own production factories (e.g. Nanotech Energy from the U.S. that raised in 2021 a $64m series D at a $550m valuation to do just that), or on working as an integrated lab facility for individual players at a reduced scale (e.g. the Chinese GAC that manufactures both batteries and vehicles), or on working on different graphene composition types either better suited for different purposes altogether and/or unable to reach the scale and cost-effectiveness of the company (like Australia based GMG Graphene, Luxembourg based OCSiAl Group, or US based Lyten).

3\. The company is showing an incredible velocity in moving from lab to market in only 2 years and is the only focusing on embedding its technology into battery production from multiple players at scale.\*

4\. The founders are amazing at \*\*pulling key people into the project\*\* and the company has matured to the point to have industry experts either joining and opening doors for them from the inside, or advising them and opening them from the outside

fields.Summary: Full-electric aerospace propulsion engines for drones, hovercrafts, eVTOLs and aircrafts using patented technology to reduce both noise (psycho-acoustically) and energy consumption.
fields.Deal investment thesis:
1\. Combination of team from Automotive, Defence and Aerospace (both supply and propulsion R&D) having come up with a unique approach to reduce a) perceived noise, b) energy consumption, and c) time to market (via inherently safe design requiring less testing for certification + strong supply chain partnerships)

2\. Growing demand for energy efficient drones (military and delivery) and incoming regulations (eg in Germany) restricting noise based on psychoaousic instead of pure dB (volume)

3\. Potential to enter the eVTOL and electric aircraft aviation space as a 'picks and shovels' player with revenues coming in from another, existing, billion-dollar market (drones)

--

The end-to-end creation of electric engines for aerospace is extremely hard and in the context of electric aircraft, they also need to be quiet, efficient, safe and cost effective. 

Rolls Royce tried to do so while the founder led their air taxi project and they gave up, which is why he started the business. The co-founders have been working on this challenge for 3 years and their first product is already 3X quieter and 2X more efficient than competition. 

The company is in the GP the only credible startup in this market that has the combination of strong team + deep expertise + supply chain exclusivity + critical academic partnerships + manufacturing processes + IP + insights to build a full stack electric propulsion company of the future.
